messages:
Ops Bot: rollout notice 8: New Dedicated pool 'tempest-lon3' is live in LON3. Initial size: 30 Tempest-T instances. Tags: #dedicated #tempest #lon3 :sparkles:
Liam F: short explainer for folks who missed the sync: Tempest-T is our new throughput-optimized GPU SKU (marketing name). Target: mixed chat + reranking + medium KV RAG. VRAM ~80GB effective. Expect 10-22% cost improvement vs our h100 baseline depending on workload shape.
Anika P: reservation model? can we reserve for steady traffic?
Platform Eng: launch mode is tiered: 35% reserved commit, 40% short-term commitment (7-30d rolling), 25% burst. Short-term commits are billed at a mid-tier rate and are intended for teams that want predictability without annual terms.
Liam F: CLI example to reserve a 14-day short commit:
```
redwood reserve --pool tempest-lon3 --count 3 --duration 14d --commit short --tags team=search europe-beta
```
Billing Bot: billing notes: new SKU 'dedicated.tempest' effective today. Meter: per-instance-minute for burst/short, per-instance-hour for reserved monthly/annual. Intro promo: 5% discount for teams that sign a short commit and route production traffic for at least 7 days. Apply tag `europe-beta` to qualify.
Anika P: fallback behavior if pool is exhausted?
Platform Eng: fallback chain: tempest-lon3 -> tempest-lon3-compat (mixed h100/tempest) -> lon1-standard -> global-h100. Console has a strict-routing toggle to prevent automatic failover.
Infra Oncall: ops note: Tempest burst instances are soft-preemptible during LON maintenance windows. Short commits get best-effort affinity but may be reclaimed in extreme capacity events. Reserved monthly/annual commits are non-preemptible. We'll publish maintenance windows in #infra-maintenance.
Liam F: model compatibility/quantization?
Platform Eng: supported quant paths: 8-bit and dynamic 4-bit. Two model_profile options: tempest-default and tempest-kv-large (for heavy KV). No runtime ABI changes. If you see numerical regressions, open an eval and tag Optimize.
Anika P: fairshare or regional weighting? we need to prioritize regional customers during eu peak.
Platform Eng: Tempest pools in EU use weighted fairshare: weight = recent regional usage * team_signal. Teams with `team=` tags get priority during peak. This is an opt-in pilot; feedback encouraged.
Billing Bot: operational tip: always include `team=` tag on reservations so costs and fairshare weight map correctly in Console.
Liam F: performance contact details?
Infra Oncall: for perf regressions tag @Infra Oncall and post p50/p95, error rate, and a short repro or request id. Threshold to escalate: >6% error delta or >20% p95 increase after migration.
Ops Bot: rollout timeline: day 0 (this soft-open), day 5 expand to 60 instances if health signals are green, day 14 enable annual commit UI and short-commit analytics in Console. Docs: https://intra.redwood.dev/dedicated/tempest-lon3 (internal).
Liam F: tiny ops tip  set `model_profile=tempest-kv-large` for RAG routes with >16GB KV to avoid spills.
Infra Oncall: health checks running now; expect short warmup spikes in telemetry dashboards. Will update here if anything unexpected shows up. :mag:
Anika P: thanks team  we'll run canaries this afternoon and report numbers.
